title: From case availability to staged expert-method replay
old_model: A source-backed case corpus and a blind split could be treated as if the system had already reproduced the expert's reasoning method.
observed_limitations: Target-palace evidence is not a full chart.
Retrieval and action selection readiness do not establish that the correct procedural method was applied.
A source outcome or expert prose can leak into blind evaluation if identities and source conclusions are not separated.
A unique target-palace anchor match is only a gate for later full-chart materialization; it is not equivalence with every source-chart annotation.
current_model: Represent corpus inventory, blind-safe evidence materialization, retrieval readiness, action-selection readiness, source-input reconstruction readiness, full-chart materialization, full expert replay, method-fidelity evaluation and predictive evaluation as separate maturity stages. The current accepted source reconstruction result evaluates 37 bounded candidates: 11 unique target-anchor matches are eligible for a later full-chart materialization step; 6 remain ambiguous, 5 do not match the anchor, and 2 are source-incomplete. Full-chart materialization and expert replay remain pending.
rationale: The accepted Wang corpus/readiness artifacts distinguish 24 target-palace anchors from full charts. Product #545 / PR #554 adds a pinned, source-bounded candidate reconstruction probe and classifies all 37 candidate inputs without collapsing ambiguity.
consequences: Materialize full charts and bind method patterns to case target scopes before claiming replay.
Keep source identities, expert reasoning, conclusions, outcomes and external biography out of blind views.
Use the first benchmark to test method reconstruction, not real-world predictive accuracy.
Only UNIQUE_ANCHOR_MATCH cases may proceed to the separate full-chart materialization work unit; ambiguous, no-match, source-incomplete or engine-unsupported cases remain withheld.
what_remains_valid: The 24 source cases and LOCO split are useful structured assets.
Target-palace facts can support bounded retrieval/action-selection diagnostics.
The method-policy readiness file is useful for identifying blockers, not as a performance score.
